courses.description: The “Science and Development of Reading” course provides a comprehensive exploration of the cognitive, psychological, and educational aspects of reading acquisition and literacy development. This course delves into the science behind how individuals learn to read, the cognitive processes involved in reading comprehension, and effective instructional strategies that support reading development across diverse populations. From the foundational elements of phonological awareness to the neuroscientific underpinnings of reading, students will gain valuable insights into the intricacies of reading and its importance in today's information-driven world.
outcomes: Demonstrate content knowledge and the applications of the underlying principles and theories of reading and reading development.
Apply the identified research-based principles and approaches in developing basic skills in reading comprehension.

soMap.description: Communicate effectively with the computing community and with society at large about complex computing activities by being able to comprehend and write effective reports, design documentation make effective presentations, and give and understand clear instructions.
Communicate effectively in speaking, writing and presenting using culturally appropriate language.
